entities.summary: Nathan Mensah is a Ghanaian professional basketball player for U-BT Cluj-Napoca of the Romanian Liga Națională, the ABA League and the EuroCup. Known for his 7-foot-5-inch (226 cm) wingspan, he played college basketball for the San Diego State Aztecs.
